hypothesis.description: One sentence: what must be true of the data if the claim holds.

pass_criterion.description: Pre-registered measured value and threshold that confirms the claim.

fail_criterion.description: Pre-registered measured result that refutes it.

interpretation.description: How the author's terms map to measurable quantities; note any modern reinterpretation.

id.description: kebab-case slug you assign, e.g. gbif-occurrence-amphibia

name.description: The dataset's actual title as its publisher gives it.

landing_url.description: A real https URL of the dataset's landing page. Must resolve.

doi.description: The dataset's DOI as 10.xxxx/..., or null if it has none. Never guess.

no_dataset_reason.description: If dataset is null: why no suitable public dataset exists.

identifiers.description: Every URL and DOI that appears anywhere in this plan, including landing_url and doi.
